think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s documented purpose and normal numeric range. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value(s) (commonly 0 or -1) switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto/infinite) rather than just ‘less/more’. 3) If such a value exists, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
